# RFutils

> Coordination files in, any other format out, frequencies solved

An RF suite for radio mics. The conversion and coordination half runs entirely in a browser: drop in a Wireless Workbench or WSM export, or an Ofcom PMSE licence PDF, and get your files back. Nothing is uploaded: the parsers, the .shw generator and the coordination engine all run on your own machine, in the page.

In a browser it has Convert, Coordination, Inventory and Allocation. Monitor and Deployment (discovering receivers, decoding AES67 audio and programming frequencies) need sockets a web page can't open, so for those you run RFutils locally: there are prebuilt apps for macOS, Windows and Linux.

It runs in the browser at https://rfutils.stoatworks-labs.com/ and is free to use.
